contexts.text: As this (hereditary from the mother) was extirpated...
(This truth) is extirpated in the other life.
Occurs. AC 3701:3.
The extirpation of the nations of Canaan.
Concupiscences are to be extirpated.
That the Jewish nation was not to be extirpated. Signified.
When a man is being regenerated, the hereditary evil inrooted from the nearest parents is extirpated.
That they extirpated the truths of doctrine of the Church with the ancients. Signified. AC 4502.
To burn is predicated of the extirpation of good.
The extirpation of the truth of the external and internal Church. Signified.
That evil and falsity was extirpated. Signified.
With the Lord the prior forms which were from the maternal, were completely blotted out and extirpated.
Occurs. AC 9258:4.
Under Evil, see this reference. AC 9937:4. DP 79.
The casting out of the Church, and thus the extirpation of such falsities. Signified.
The dominant love is not extirpated to eternity. HH 393:end.
Confirmed falsity... cannot be extirpated.
Confirmed evil and falsity cannot be extirpated after death; it is extirpated only in the world by means of repentance.
Then the Lord extirpates the concupiscences at the same time.
Still, evil is not extirpated, but is only removed. TCR 614.
Iniquity once inrooted... is extirpated only by regeneration...
Occurs. SE 2787. AE 955:5. AE 1164:2. Ath 64. Ath 5M 7.
